Naemi Herzig

  • Position Forward
  • Height 5-5
  • Class Sophomore
  • Hometown St. Gallen, Switzerland

Biography

• Will serve as one of Holy Cross’ alternate captains
• Has the ninth-most career faceoff wins of any Holy Cross player in the Hockey East era (204)

HONORS & AWARDS:
• American Hockey Coaches Association All-America Scholar (2025-2026)
• Hockey East All-Academic Team (2025-2026)

AS A FRESHMAN IN 2025-2026:
• Named an American Hockey Coaches Association All-American Scholar
• Selected to the Hockey East All-Academic Team
• Played in 26 games, finishing the season at +7
• Ranked second on the team in scoring with 22 points on seven goals and 15 assists
• Went 204-137 on faceoffs blocked 17 shots
• Placed second on the school Hockey East era single-season lists for points and assists, while standing sixth for plus-minus and ninth for goals scored
• Had a season-high three points on a goal and two assists in the win over Assumption (Nov. 29)
• Named the Hockey East Rookie of the Week after tallying a goal and an assist in the victory at Boston University (Jan. 17)
• Recorded a goal and an assist in the win over Maine (Nov. 15)
• Picked up two assists against both Boston College (Jan. 9) and Delaware (Oct. 4)
• Scored the game-winning goal against Post (Oct. 24)
• Netted her first career goal against Dartmouth (Oct. 17)

SWISS NATIONAL TEAM:
• A member of the Swiss national team since 2023
• Won a bronze medal for Switzerland at the 2026 Winter Olympics
• The first Winter Olympic medalist and female Olympic medalist in Holy Cross history
• Saw action in all seven of Switzerland’s games at the 2026 Olympics, playing 144 total shifts and seeing 91:25 of ice time
• Part of Switzerland’s teams at the 2024 and 2025 IIHF World Championships, helping the Swiss to a pair of fifth place finishes
• Previously a member of Switzerland’s under-18 national team
• Served as a captain for the Swiss team at the 2024 under-18 world championship
• Tallied a goal and an assist at the 2023 under-18 world championship

HIGH SCHOOL & JUNIOR HOCKEY:
• Played for EV Zug under head coach Daniela Diaz
• Totaled four goals and five assists for nine points during the 2024-2025 season
• Tallied 70 points on 39 goals and 40 assists in 22 games in 2023-2024, while helping the team win the SWHL B championships
• Previously played for the ZSC Lions in 2023-2023, recording six goals and five assists for 11 points in 19 games played
• Attended OYM College in Cham, Switzerland

PERSONAL:
• Majoring in Economics
• Chose Holy Cross because of the college’s strong values and the great opportunities available both academically and athletically
